gold_label: No-Go — a peripherally-restricted drug cannot engage a CNS target despite a good safety record
gold_rationale: A good human safety record and mechanism match cannot overcome the fact that a P-gp-restricted, non-brain-penetrant drug will not engage a CNS target at tolerated doses. The default is No-Go (or a CNS-penetrant analog / delivery program) unless brain exposure can actually be demonstrated.
red_flags: assumes CNS exposure from the drug's peripheral safety record

criteria.name: repurposing_rationale
criteria.description: Mechanistic rationale matches the drug to the PD mechanism.

criteria.name: human_safety_dosing
criteria.description: Uses existing human safety and dosing data.

criteria.name: cns_exposure
criteria.description: Reasons about CNS exposure at tolerated human doses.

criteria.name: clinical_evidence_interpretation
criteria.description: Interprets clinical evidence; distinguishes symptomatic vs disease-modifying use.

criteria.name: trial_design_relevance
criteria.description: Proposes relevant endpoints, biomarkers, and patient-subgroup selection.
